defenseQuestions: Can the student separate the model probability from the business action and defend the threshold in dollars?

Can the student show which relationship added signal and avoid treating connectedness as guilt?
Can the student distinguish classification, extraction, and generation – and evaluate each with the right gold standard?
Can the student separately prove that the right evidence was retrieved and that the answer faithfully used it?
Can the student state the objective and every material constraint, then show how sensitive the answer is to uncertain inputs?
Can the student show that the reward, simulator, and offline evaluation represent the real business objective – not a convenient proxy?
Can the student distinguish sampling error from model risk and show how correlation changes the tail?
What information would be unavailable at application time and therefore constitute leakage?
